title: Founding Full-Stack Engineer
description:
Founding Full-Stack Engineer
Build the software systems around planqor.ai: the real-time decision layer that steers discrete manufacturing when production plans get disrupted. Born on the shop floor, co-founded by senior production experts, and with direct access to high-impact industry problems. Work directly with our CTO and shape a greenfield product spanning Python backend, data, visualization, frontend, infrastructure, and integration with our optimization core. Backed by investors who have built and scaled successful companies. Remote-first or from our office in Munich, competitive pay + VSOP, no puzzle interviews.
The opportunity
Factories have invested billions in automation, yet production is still steered largely by people. Every night, a plan is computed for the next day, and the first disruption makes it obsolete. From then on, planners and shift leads juggle dependencies by hand. That is expensive, rarely optimal, and wastes much of what these factories were built for.
We are building the layer that takes over when the plan gets disrupted. It connects to factory data, models production, detects disruptions and bottlenecks as they emerge, simulates responses and recommends the best one.
About us
planqor.ai was born on the shop floor. Our founding team brings deep production expertise, strong industry networks. We have the runway to build deliberately and the experience of people who have built and scaled successful companies before. On the technical side, we combine deep algorithmic and software-engineering competence with modern optimization methods, GenAI-assisted development and fast, pragmatic iteration. We are in stealth and very early, which means you can shape much of what comes next.
What you'll own
The product layer: Turn complex optimization systems into software planners can actually use.

Backend and data: Build Python services, APIs, data models, and pipelines around our optimization engine.

Interfaces and visualization: Make schedules, bottlenecks, dependencies, and alternative decisions understandable and interactive.

Integration: Connect native C++ components, factory data, and product workflows into one coherent system.

Infrastructure: Own CI/CD, containers, deployment, observability, and the supporting services we need.

The team: Grow into leading software engineering at planqor.ai as we scale: hiring, mentoring, and setting direction.

You set your own priorities and structure your work toward clear goals. No ticket queue, no micromanagement.
How we build
Our product sits at the boundary between algorithms, software systems, and real industrial operations.
We care about building systems that are easy to integrate, responsive, understandable, and maintainable as both the product and the underlying algorithms evolve.
We use GenAI extensively to prototype, implement, and explore alternatives. But generating code is not the hard part. The value lies in designing the right system, choosing good abstractions, validating behavior, and knowing what is worth building.
There are no points for cleverness. The simplest system that reliably solves the real problem wins.
What you'll bring
Strong Python and backend engineering. You are comfortable designing APIs, services, libraries, and maintainable system boundaries.

Full-stack product skills. You can work with TypeScript, React, or similar technologies and build interfaces that make complex systems understandable.

Data and integration. You can design data models and pipelines, work with databases, and connect messy external systems to clean internal interfaces.

Systems thinking. You think beyond individual services or screens: how data, algorithms, product, and infrastructure fit together.

Infrastructure fundamentals. You are comfortable with Docker, CI/CD, deployment, observability, and operating services.

Independence. You can turn an underspecified operational problem into working software without waiting for a detailed spec.

Fluent English. German and experience in manufacturing or industrial planning are useful but not required.

Bonus: C++ and native Python bindings such as pybind11 or nanobind; data visualization; optimization, scheduling, simulation, or other algorithmic systems; enterprise integrations such as ERP / SAP.
What you'll get
Real ownership: shape the product architecture from line one, working directly with our CTO.

A clear growth path into leading the software engineering team.

A real problem worth solving.

We equip you with the hardware, compute, and tools you work best with.

Remote-first or from our Munich office, with regular in-person workshops.

Competitive pay + VSOP.

The process (fast, real conversations, no puzzles)
Send your CV.

Talk with our CTO about your work and how you approach hard problems.

Meet our CEO and selected investors.

More at home in C++, algorithms, and optimization? Check out our Founding Optimization Engineer role.

title: Senior Full Stack (Node.js) Engineer

Enable teams: configure assistants, skills, hooks and MCP servers; pair with engineers and share proven practices

Full-stack & Versatility: Broad technical perspective with an emphasis on adaptability across modern software stacks and architectures, favoring breadth and quick ramp-up over narrow specialization

Frontend & TypeScript: Strong production experience with modern React and TypeScript (including Node.js, async patterns, testing, and monorepo tooling).

Infrastructure as Code: Able to read and safely modify Terraform configurations across environments

Data: Hands-on experience with both NoSQL and SQL stores, including schema changes and live-system migrations

Observability: Able to design metrics, logs, and alarms for non-deterministic systems, and effectively debug production issues from them

CI/CD: Proficiency with modern CI/CD pipelines, ideally GitLab CI/CD

Communication: Fluent written and spoken English, with the ability to articulate trade- offs clearly and align team members around technical decisions

Desirable:
Multi-agent systems, MCP servers, or evaluation frameworks

LLM cost control: model routing, prompt caching, token budgets

Prompt-injection defense and agent security

GraphQL for internal APIs and tooling

Code intelligence or retrieval work (indexing, symbol search, knowledge bundles)

Kubernetes, AWS AppSync, and EventBridge

Playwright/Cucumber test automation

Claude Certified Developer or Claude Certified Architect (Anthropic)

Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment

Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise

Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies

With delivery centers in Wrocław and Gdańsk, our 300+ professionals in Poland drive forward-thinking solutions for global clients. Join a community where collaboration sparks innovation—and your impact reaches millions.

Your work will include accelerating TypeScript feedback, automating migrations, simplifying development environments, and evolving shared application foundations. As AI changes how software is built, you will help create the reliable builds, fast tests, and repeatable workflows that support engineers and coding agents.

Collaborate with product and infrastructure teams to balance technical requirements, developer needs, and business goals

Mentor engineers and contribute to team development through technical guidance, code reviews, and shared engineering standards

9+ years of professional experience in full-stack development

BS degree or higher in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent experience

title: Senior Web Engineer - Subscriptions
description:
The Subscriptions Mission is shaping the future of how millions of people discover, purchase, and experience Spotify Premium. We build the platforms and tools that power Spotify's global subscription business, enabling new offers, pricing strategies, and commerce experiences that help our business move quickly while delivering exceptional experiences for listeners.

Join the Monaco squad, where we create the internal products that enable Spotify teams to launch, configure, and manage Premium offers with confidence. From subscriptions and prepaid products to pricing updates and promotional campaigns, our tools support business-critical operations through intuitive experiences, trusted workflows, and reliable platform services.

As a Senior Web Engineer, you'll develop end-to-end solutions spanning modern web applications. Working closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and business partners, you'll help create the tools that enable Spotify's global subscription business to innovate safely, efficiently, and at scale.

What You'll Do

Build end-to-end features across modern web applications that support Spotify's global subscription business.

Create intuitive internal products that enable business teams to launch, configure, and manage Premium offers through secure, guided workflows.

Develop GraphQL and gRPC APIs that connect frontend applications with distributed platform services.

Design efficient database schemas, implement data migrations, and optimize application performance using PostgreSQL.

Build secure, reliable, and auditable systems that support business-critical financial operations and SOX-compliant approval workflows.

Collaborate with engineers across the Subscriptions Mission to evolve shared platform capabilities, improve developer experience, and increase platform reliability.

Write maintainable, well-tested code while contributing to technical design, architecture discussions, code reviews, and continuous improvement.

Participate in an on-call rotation to help maintain the reliability and availability of services powering Spotify Premium.

Who You Are

You have experience building and delivering production software across on the front end.

You have built modern web applications using TypeScript, React, and Next.js.

You have experience designing or consuming GraphQL APIs and enjoy building schema-driven applications.

You have worked with gRPC services and Protocol Buffers, or you're excited to deepen your expertise in distributed systems.

You have hands-on experience with PostgreSQL or another relational database, including schema design, migrations, and query optimization.

You care about writing reliable, maintainable, and well-tested software that delivers long-term value.

You enjoy partnering with engineers, designers, product managers, and business stakeholders to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful outcomes.

You have a passion for simplifying complex workflows and creating intuitive experiences for internal users.

Experience with tools such as jOOQ, Flyway, Apollo GraphQL, DataLoader, Styled Components, Storybook, TanStack Query, Tailwind CSS, Material UI, or similar technologies will help you ramp up quickly.

Experience building commerce platforms, subscription products, pricing systems, distributed systems, or large-scale platform modernization initiatives is beneficial.

Where You'll Be

We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the EMEA region as long as we have a work location.

This team operates within the Central European and GMT time zones for collaboration.

Compensation

Additional Information

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! An overview of this role

Data Products integrates GitLab and third-party SDLC data, and builds the dashboards, APIs, and data products that turn it into trusted, interoperable intelligence for customers and internal teams.

This is a 0 to 1 team and we are hiring for a foundational engineering role. That means you bring technical leadership through ambiguity, helping figure out what to build, making the foundational design decisions, and keeping delivery moving while the picture is still forming. You own the full lifecycle of what ships and stand behind it.

What you'll bring

  • Proven ability to influence as a Staff owning product or platform systems end to end across multiple engineering and product teams.
  • High agency, i.e finds the owner, clarifies the path, makes the call, and keeps pushing until the work lands.
  • Force multiplier and raise the people and the codebase around them
  • Deep full-stack expertise, including strong proficiency in Go, Ruby and Node. 
  • Depth in at least one of analytics and metrics platforms, graph data systems, CDC and warehouse integration.
  • Hands-on experience building production AI-powered tool orchestration.
  • Experience operating multi-tenant systems across SaaS and self-managed deployment.
  • Direct communicator who builds alignment across teams.
  • Bias to write things down and make reasoning legible.

What you'll own

  • Architect how GitLab and third-party data is ingested, modeled, and synced into the knowledge graph as a near-real-time graph of the development ecosystem.
  • Lead integration with external systems for business context (Jira, observability tools, Zendesk, ServiceNow), indexed into the graph.
  • Architect the Data Marketplace so customers consume GitLab data through Snowflake, Databricks, and BigQuery with no engineering dependencies.
  • Publish GitLab observability as OpenTelemetry and broker the data-sharing APIs.
  • Define operational readiness for everything the team ships across GitLab.com, Dedicated, and Self-Managed.
  • Translate an ambiguous 0 to 1 problem space into concrete, iterable roadmaps in partnership with Product, Design, and the graph backend team.
  • Resolve cross-team dependencies across graph backend, AI Platform, and Infrastructure without escalating everything upward.
  • Mentor senior and intermediate engineers through design reviews, pairing, and code review.

Dashboard and Reporting Framework

    • Builds AI-native dashboard components so customers and internal teams can see engineering health and GitLab's impact across DORA, VSA, AI Impact, SDLC trends, security, and quality, and launch their own custom dashboards on the same framework.

Internal Ingestion

    • Ingests third-party data into the GitLab and power tools like Knowledge Graph, building connectors so that signals from systems like Jira, Zendesk, ServiceNow, and observability tools become one queryable, near-real-time graph of the developer ecosystem.

External Ingestion 

    • External makes GitLab and Knowledge Graph data consumable outside the product, through marketplace listings, data-sharing APIs and SDKs, and co-branded partner products.

We are a new team in a highly ambiguous, high-impact space, and we need engineers who can create clarity while building, make practical tradeoffs, unblock cross-team dependencies, and keep pushing until meaningful customer value lands.

You'll collaborate with product management, product design, testing, security, user experience research, technical writing, Gitaly, Code Review, and the other Source Code teams.

What you'll do
  • Develop secure, well-tested, performant features and improvements using Ruby and GraphQL.
  • Work through complex requirements and legacy constraints to deliver clear solutions while protecting the reliability of this critical system.
  • Design and maintain backend services, application programming interfaces, data models, and business logic that control how code reaches a repository, who may change it, and how it is verified.
  • Build on the primitives Gitaly provides and work closely with the Gitaly team.
  • Triage and fix bugs and support requests for the features the team owns.
  • Collaborate across functions and teams, both asynchronously and synchronously, and involve domain experts when their input will improve the outcome.
  • Use artificial intelligence agents for well-scoped work when they can speed up delivery without sacrificing quality, and critically review their output.
  • Write maintainable code that follows GitLab's standards and contribute to constructive code reviews.
  • Help strengthen reliability by monitoring production health metrics, participating in Tier 2 on-call, troubleshooting incidents, contributing to root cause analysis, and improving observability and resiliency.
  • Share knowledge through code review, technical documentation, and everyday collaboration while learning from others.
  • Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.

  • Experience contributing to user-facing workflows and maintaining their underlying systems.
  • Experience writing backend unit and integration tests, with familiarity with the testing pyramid, Git, and collaborative code review processes.
  • Experience using artificial intelligence coding agents and reviewing their output, or an interest in building these skills in a complex monorepo.
  • Clear written and spoken English communication skills, including sharing useful status updates in a remote, asynchronous environment.
  • The ability to manage assigned priorities, work through ambiguity, take ownership of your work, and seek guidance when needed.

About the team
Repository Services is a small backend team in the Create stage, formed in September 2026 when Source Code split into focused teams. As the split is finalized we expect to own repository mirroring, Git Large File Storage (LFS), protected branches and Branch Rules, push rules, Code Owners (shared with Code Review), and commit and tag signing. We build on Gitaly's primitives and meet regularly with the Gitaly team, and our work serves GitLab.com, self-managed instances, and GitLab Dedicated.

title: Remote Office Assistant
description:
Coalition Technologies is seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and highly organized Remote Office Assistant to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, data entry, and internal operations tasks. This role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, discretion, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow within a fast-paced remote work environment.

As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. This position offers strong growth potential for the right candidate, including opportunities for advancement within the Accounting team or other departments.

We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.

 

Why Join Coalition Technologies?

Coalition Technologies is committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients while providing our team with a fun, thriving, innovative, and growth-focused work environment. We offer:

100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade

Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month

Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance

Subsidized gym memberships

Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members

International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members

Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs

Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards

Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses

 

Office Assistant Responsibilities

As an Office Assistant, your duties will include:

Answering phones and emails

Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records

Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members

Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members

Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports

Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments

Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry

Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year

Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year

Facilitating company holiday calendars, time-off calendars, and schedule variation calendars

 

Required Skills and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have:

Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole

Excellent verbal and written communication skills

High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness

Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks

Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible

Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time

Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers

 

Preferred Skills

The following experience is preferred but not required:

Intermediate spreadsheet skills

Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping

Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace

Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations

 

Remote Work Environment

Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world.

 

Growth Opportunity

This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments.

 

Compensation

For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Lemon.io helps companies in the US and Europe hire experienced engineers, from funded startups to teams like Klarna, Retool, and Pinterest. We’ve been doing this since 2015, and more than 1,500 companies have hired engineers through us.

 

New roles for Senior React Full-stack Engineers come in all the time, and several are open right now.

 

Two ways to work with clients

Contract: most roles are contract-based. You join the client’s team and work as part of it.

Direct hire: some clients hire engineers full-time, and we support you through the process.

 

Because companies trust our vetting, applying through Lemon.io is often a shortcut. You get to the client faster than going through their full hiring process on your own.

 

What you get

Competitive rate, based on your seniority and skills

We find the projects. No client hunting or rate negotiations. We match you manually based on your skills and preferences.

Flexible schedule. Work async or with a small overlap with the team’s hours.

No micromanagement, no screen trackers

Direct work with clients, most of them with technical backgrounds

Ongoing support from your application through every project, plus a community of engineers from 75+ countries

 

Who we’re looking for

Senior Data Engineers with:

4+ years of commercial experience as a Data Engineer

Experience with Apache Airflow and Snowflake, or Python and SQL, is required

Experience with AWS, GCP, or Microsoft Azure is mandatory

You own problems end-to-end: you spot the issue in the data or pipeline, design and build the solution, and ship it to production.

You can show the business impact of your work with concrete results (e.g., faster data processing, lower infrastructure costs, fresher data for stakeholders, fewer pipeline incidents).

Advanced English: you discuss business tasks, explain your technical decisions, raise risks early, and present yourself and your results well on client calls.

You work full-time remotely and deliver without supervision.
